title: Computational package: Regularized Spectral Statistics for Prime Races and Low-Zero Transient Reversals
description: Complete data and code package for the joint manuscript by Shin-ya Koyama and Saar Shai: ordinary prime-count race data for N in {7,8,11,19,23} through 3e14, independently checked 1.3e13 baseline (567/567 cells), Dirichlet L-function zero tables with dual-mesh agreement gates, low-zero explicit-formula reconstructions, FLINT/Arb certification of the ultra-low modulus-19 zero, Lean 4 formalization of the finite character-algebra scope, verification report, and SHA-256 manifests. Companion theoretical preprint: arXiv:2607.28931.
